cells.gaps: The four city councils (2022) are 4 of 35 local governments, and Mwanza's receipts-only LORMIS (2025-02) is a fifth; none is named in the other 30, and no figure for the cities is held after 2022. The newest recorded fact (MWI-008) is receipts and the register is the cities' of 2022; Zomba records market receipts only. The vendor ownership (2022) and the absence of a plan (2023-08) fall outside the 36 months, and nothing is held for the last twelve months.
cells.note: Registers of payers are live in Blantyre and Mzuzu, outside the capital, in systems each council keeps for itself. Five of 35 local governments is a minority, so stage 4 is not reached.
